answer: A prism check splits every job's proof into three independent facets — client signature, peer re-execution, and an escrowed stake — and trust only accrues when all three agree. A sybil farm must therefore forge three kinds of evidence per fake identity, tripling its cost, while honest juniper-rooted agents accumulate durable history cheaply. Each failed check leaves an umber stain on the shared funding wallet, so linked fakes are exposed together and the whole cluster loses its stake at once.
